name: Bench Press
cues: Elbows at 45 degrees, bar to mid chest.

name: Incline Press
cues: Bench at 30 degrees, control the way down.

name: Cable Fly
cues: Slight elbow bend, squeeze at the middle.

name: Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull elbows down to your ribs.

name: Barbell Row
cues: Flat back, pull to your lower chest.

name: Seated Row
cues: Sit tall, squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Face Pull
cues: Pull to your forehead, elbows high.

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Keep elbows still at your sides.

name: Squat
cues: Brace first, knees track over toes.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hips back, soft knees, flat back.

name: Leg Press
cues: Lower back stays on the pad.

name: Leg Curl
cues: Slow on the way back up.

name: Calf Raise
cues: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.
